caption: Crafting this miniature metropolis required an immense amount of patience and precision, from the smallest streetlamp to the complex urban infrastructure. It’s incredible how much personality you can squeeze into such a small scale—even if a few of the residents seem to have a bit of an attitude about the moving parts! #miniature #diorama #modelmaking #miniatureworld #stopmotion
